question: What beings does Arjuna see in Krishna's body?
premises: Arjuna sees gods in Krishna's body
He sees Brahma, sages, and divine serpents
inference: Arjuna enumerates divine beings and classes of creatures within Krishna's universal form.
uncertainties: Fused sandhi forms analyzed as wholes
plain_english: Arjuna said: I see your gods in your body, O god, and all groups of beings, Brahma the lord seated on the lotus, sages, and all divine serpents.
